items.title: Pay own share for hearing aids
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Invoice is dated Thu 19 Nov 2026. The period is 30 days 'nach Rechnungsdatum', so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the invoice itself is not counted; counting starts 20 Nov 2026. 30 days later lands on Sat 19 Dec 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). Since this is a payment obligation towards a private company, the civil-law weekend/holiday shift of § 193 BGB applies: Sat 19 Dec 2026 moves to the next business day, Mon 21 Dec 2026 (no NW public holiday falls in between). To actually arrive by then, a bank transfer should be sent by Fri 18 Dec 2026 (§ 675s BGB, up to 1 business day for transfer execution), but the due date itself is 21 Dec 2026.

warnings: The letter offers installment payment 'nach Absprache' (by arrangement) with no further detail; if you want to use this, contact the provider via the phone number or email printed on the invoice to agree terms before the due date.

The IBAN DE36 3705 0198 0005 5277 00 is well-formed (checksum and format valid), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; verify the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory SEPA name-check matches 'Hörakustik Beispielklang' before paying, and compare these bank details with any earlier correspondence from this provider.
